desc:
Keep your cat's fountain running with a fresh set of filters. This pack gives you 6 complete changes for the oneisall PW04 3.5L stainless steel fountain: 6 layered filter cartridges, 6 blue foam pre-filters and 6 pump sponges, in plain neutral packaging.

Specifications:
- Fits: oneisall PW04 3.5L stainless steel pet fountain
- Contents: 6 filter cartridges, 6 foam pre-filters, 6 pump sponges
- Cartridge: filter cotton, ion-exchange resin, coconut-shell activated carbon
- Cartridge / pre-filter size: about 3.56 × 6.6 cm (1.4 × 2.6 in)
- Pump sponge: about 3.56 × 3.56 cm (1.4 × 1.4 in)
- Weight: about 80 g with package

Note: Rinse or soak new cartridges before use. Fountain not included. Orlivane is not affiliated with oneisall; the brand name is used only to show fit.
b: MADE TO FIT PW04 — Replacement filters for the oneisall PW04 3.5L stainless steel cat fountain. Check the size before ordering: cartridge about 1.4 × 2.6 in (3.56 × 6.6 cm).
6 CHANGES IN ONE PACK — 6 filter cartridges, 6 blue foam pre-filters and 6 pump sponges, so each change gets a fresh set.
LAYERED CARTRIDGE — Filter cotton, ion-exchange resin and coconut-shell activated carbon in a two-chamber cartridge.
FOAM PRE-FILTER AND PUMP SPONGE — The blue foam pre-filter sits in front of the cartridge, and the small sponge goes over the pump intake to catch hair and debris.
EASY TO START — Soak a new cartridge in clean water for 5 minutes or rinse it under the tap for 30 seconds, then fit it with a new pre-filter. Fountain not included.
